verification_level: FAST plus BATCH; one aliasing-soundness defect repaired in BN_div; two low-severity authority-fidelity/validity repairs in the ASN.1 allocator; one CBD counted-loop divergence repaired; no new boundary; hidden = 0
scope: ordinary mechanism-contract sweep starting at the queued src/pem/pem_info.rs (rank 204, 96 production sites) and continuing down the production-site ranking. Eight ordinary files audited: src/pem/pem_info.rs, src/ml_kem/arith.rs, src/pkcs12/p12_sbag.rs, src/asn1/new.rs, src/evp/encode.rs, src/bn/arith.rs, src/ml_dsa/key.rs, src/pkcs12/p12_kiss.rs. defects.class: aliasing: two live `&mut` to one allocation (Rust reference model violation)
defects.description: BN_div read its two outputs with `let (q_out, r_out, ...) = unsafe { (as_mut(dv), as_mut(rem), ...) }`. Its own documentation (and the authority's ABI comment) allows a caller to pass one object for both slots; doing so created two `&mut BigNum` to the same allocation. The authority's aliased case is undefined, so no defined C caller observes a difference, but a Rust caller satisfying the stated contract triggered UB.
defects.fix: Inputs are read through scoped shared references whose uses end before any output borrow; each output is then borrowed and released in turn. The remainder is stored first and the quotient last, so the aliased case ends with the quotient, now documented. Added control `div_accepts_one_object_for_both_outputs` (17 / 5 with dv == rem == out answers the quotient 3).

defects.class: authority divergence in a reusable allocator (reference-count initialisation)
defects.description: The SEQUENCE/NDEF_SEQUENCE embed arm skipped `ossl_asn1_do_lock`, which asn1_item_embed_new calls for embedded values too (`tasn_new.c:59-153`). No in-tree item embeds a refcounted type (only X509, X509_CRL and X509_REQ carry ASN1_AFLG_REFCOUNT, and all are pointed-to rather than embedded), so the old shape was unobservable today; a future embedded refcounted sequence would have started with an uninitialised count.
defects.fix: The embed arm now calls `utl::do_lock(pval, 0, item)` and raises TASN_NEW_162 on a negative answer, matching the authority's asn1err path. No new contract: do_lock's existing ASN1_ITEM contract is reused.

defects.class: avoidable read of a slot the authority only takes the address of
defects.description: template_new ran `let mut tval = unsafe { *pval }` before the embed branch, then wrote the same value back. The authority's `tval = (ASN1_VALUE *)pval` only takes the slot's address and never reads it. Current callers always hand over zeroed storage, so no UB was reachable; a future caller with an uninitialised embedded slot would have hit an uninitialised read.
defects.fix: The pre-read and write-back are removed; the embed branch sets `tval = pval.cast::<c_void>()` exactly as the authority does, and the temporary is assigned only on that branch (no unused initialiser).

defects.class: counted-loop divergence at rank == 0 (unsound contract as written)
defects.description: gencbd_vector and gencbd_vector_ntt used a do-while shape: with rank == 0 they sampled one scalar into an `out` documented live for zero scalars, while ml_kem.c's `for (i = 0; i < rank; i++)` performs no sample and still returns success. No in-tree caller passes a non-positive rank (vinfo rank is 2-4), but the stated contract admitted rank == 0.
defects.fix: Both drivers now use the authority's counted loop and answer success when rank <= 0. Preconditions for inner_product, matrix_mult_intt, matrix_mult_transpose_add, hash_h_pubkey, encrypt_cpa and decrypt_cpa now state `rank >= 1` (their first action reads/writes one scalar) and the two CPA functions state their message/r/ctext/out widths.

residuals: The read-before-write `as_mut(r)` + `as_ref(a)` shape used by BN_add/BN_sub/BN_uadd/BN_usub/BN_mul/BN_sqr/BN_nnmod/BN_mod_inverse/lshift/rshift is sound under the Stacked/Tree Borrows access order (all shared uses end before the write through the unique borrow), but it has no Miri witness and is PENDING at the next BOUNDARY trigger. The same shape exists in src/bn/gf2m.rs, src/bn/mont.rs and src/bn/recp.rs, which are outside this batch.
BN_div's aliased-output result (the quotient) is a deliberate defined value where the authority's aliased case is unspecified; no defined caller observes it.
compress/decompress require bits in 1..=12; an out-of-range bits value panics in this crate (safe Rust function, not UB) and the authority's internal callers pass only 4/10.
p12_sbag's get0_*/get1_* readers require a well-formed selector/value pair (as the authority does); a hand-built bag with a matching outer type and NULL value is a caller-contract violation.
Line coordinates remain the crate's established convention; no CRYPTO_* seam coordinate was changed in this batch.
